About the publication

Context from Japan, in clear English.

Japan Daily Brief explains the news, culture, language and daily life shaping Japan. It is for international readers who want to understand why a story matters—not simply receive another translated headline.

Writer · Creator · Guide

Yuji Shimizu
YUJI @ Japan

Yuji connects Japanese places, everyday culture, language learning and digital storytelling. He is also the creator of DraMap, a role-playing Japanese-learning app for iPhone and iPad.

Editorial standards

  • We distinguish reported facts, analysis and opinion.
  • We link to primary documents and reliable reporting wherever possible.
  • Headlines may create curiosity, but the article must fully and accurately reward that curiosity.
  • We write original reporting and explanation; we do not republish articles or unlicensed photography.
  • We publish dates, author names, corrections and material updates.
  • Automated tools may assist research and drafting, but publication remains accountable to the publisher.

Ownership and commercial disclosure

Japan Daily Brief is owned and operated by Yuji Shimizu. Yuji also creates DraMap. Promotional placements for DraMap are house advertising, not independent third-party endorsements. News selection and factual sourcing are kept separate from promotional claims.
